title: Braised Chicken with Slovakian Twist
description: A hearty dish that combines the flavors of traditional braising with a hint of Slovakian flair, featuring tender chicken in a rich sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken with kissed and slovakian.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Soften the onion in the same pot, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, caraway seeds, and bay leaves to the pot. Cook for 1 minute.
Add braised to the pot, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the chicken to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the chicken for 25-30 minutes, or until tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
